tools.name: lion_declare_need
tools.description: FREE router. Tell LION what you need in plain language. Returns the one paid path to call next (wallet screen $0.001, company research $0.03, enrich $0.04, compliance $0.05, VCF $0.95). Call this first when unsure which tool to use.

tools.name: lion_quick_intel
tools.description: FREE teaser for a company/domain. Does not return a full dossier. Upgrade: lion_company_research ($0.03) or lion_verified_company_file ($0.95).

tools.name: lion_wallet_screen
tools.description: Use when you have a 0x address and need PASS/WARN/BLOCK before paying anyone. Not for company names — use lion_multi_sanctions_bundle or lion_compliance_bundle. $0.001 Base USDC. [x402 paid: GET /api/x402/wallet-screen-json]

tools.name: lion_multi_sanctions_bundle
tools.description: Use when you have an address AND/OR entity name/domain and need a signed multi-list receipt. Prefer over lion_wallet_screen when you need more than OFAC SDN. $0.02 Base USDC. [x402 paid: GET /api/x402/multi-sanctions-bundle-json]

tools.name: lion_company_research
tools.description: Default company call: one-shot web + firmographics + domain trust by name or domain. Use lion_company_enrich if you only need name/employees/country. Use lion_verified_company_file for KYB source trail. $0.03 Base USDC. [x402 paid: GET /api/x402/company-research]

tools.name: lion_company_enrich
tools.description: Firmographics only (name, employees, country, industry, website). Not a web-research pack — use lion_company_research for that. $0.04 Base USDC. [x402 paid: GET /api/x402/company-enrich]

tools.name: lion_compliance_bundle
tools.description: Full counterparty pack: OFAC + entity sanctions + domain + firmographics + signed receipt. Use instead of stacking wallet_screen + research. Needs an address. $0.05 Base USDC. [x402 paid: GET /api/x402/compliance-bundle-json]

tools.name: lion_verified_company_file
tools.description: Full attested KYB dossier by domain ($0.95). Use after lion_company_research/enrich when you need per-field source trail. Not a first call. $0.95 Base USDC. [x402 paid: GET /api/x402/verified-company-file-json]
